apply_distortion_radial: apply radial distortion to 2D image points using simple one-parameter model
apply_distortion_camera: apply radial camera distortion to 2D image points using two-parameter model
apply_distortion_opencv: apply OpenCV distortion model to 2D image points with radial and tangential parameters
undistort_tracks_single: undistort normalized tracks once using given distortion parameters
undistort_tracks_iterative: iteratively undistort normalized tracks using Newton-Raphson method with Jacobian
